name: duck
description: Ducktor: a research mentor built on Supervisor-Skills. Runs the research skills as $duck:duck-* commands and opens up the why behind each AI step, so you can still learn while the AI does the work. Trust me, I'm a Ducktor.

interface.shortDescription: Research mentor that explains the why
interface.longDescription: Runs the Supervisor-Skills research skills (survey, idea evaluation, outlining, writing, polishing, figures, review) and explains the reasoning behind each step so the student learns.
